International Day Against Drug Abuse Observed in India

India observed the International Day Against Drug Abuse, with calls for a drug-free India to achieve a developed nation status. This initiative is seen as crucial for saving millions of lives. In Rewa, over 5,000 bottles of alcohol and beer were destroyed by a JCB as part of the observance, aiming to spread a message of de-addiction.
